restoration_note: The teaching enumerates seven works by which the Living Spirit (Divine Wisdom in its operative shaping power) builds the cosmic order as a vessel for the redemption of captive Light. Restoration was strongly constrained by: (1) the formulaic ordinal headings (ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍ-X ⲭⲉ ⲁϩ-) which fix gaps {3}, {6}, {7}, {26}; (2) standard Manichaean technical phrasings (Pearl-from-Sea, Ambassador-manifesting-glorious-Image, Aeons of Light, Last Andrias) which fix {28}, {41}, {42}, {52}, {53}; (3) line-break completions of damaged words (cosmos, Zone, manifest, building) which fix {9}, {16}-{21}, {24}-{34}, {44}, {46}, {48}, {50}, {51}; and (4) the spiritual reading's identification of the Living Spirit's three actions on the dead substances (bind/spread/crucify) and the bearing of the Zone by the Five Sons. Six gaps remained too damaged or weakly constrained to fill with confidence: {13} (only ⲡⲗⲉ- visible in a broken line of unknown reference), {22} (2-char fragment ⲁⲉ̣ at sentence boundary), {43} (verb stem ⲛϩ_ⲃⲉ ambiguous between candidates), {45}, {47}, and {49} (large lacunae at section breaks with no formulaic anchor).

restorations.basis: Confirms editor: continues ⲥⲁϣϥ̄ 'seven' from line 22 and matches the chapter title 'Seven works the Living Spirit performed.' The whole reading frames cosmogony as sevenfold regenerative work.

Indefinite article completing ⲧⲍⲉ ⲛ̄[ⲟⲩ]ⲗⲙⲁⲣⲅⲁⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ 'in the manner of a pearl' (the dialectal initial-l before the Greek loan margaritēs is preserved here). The simile of the Pearl raised from the Sea is the controlling image of the first work.
Circumstantial verbal form needed between 'pearl' and 'up out of the sea': the pearl is brought up from the salty mingled-state. ϫⲓ/ⲛ̄ⲧ family fits; exact form low.
Ordinal-heading formula: parallels ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ (third, line 10), ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍⲥⲁⲩ (sixth, line 20), ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍⲥⲁϣϥ̄ (seventh, line 26). Introduces second work: the spreading-and-crucifying of the Living Soul.
Perfect prefix ⲁϥ- before ⲙⲁϩ ('fill,' the qualitative-stem present here): the dispersal of the Living Soul / Cross of Light fills every body — Divine Truth crucified in every natural form.

Completes ⲁϩ[ⲙⲟⲩⲣ] in series with ⲁϩϣⲱⲣ ⲁϩⲧⲱϭⲥ ('he bound, spread out, and crucified the substances of death'). Reading: the dead substances are stretched out, fixed, and held — bind/spread/crucify is the standard Manichaean triad of fastening the dark powers in cosmic structure.
Ordinal-heading formula introducing the fourth work (establishment of the ships of light = sun and moon, the doctrinal vessels of ascent).
Confirms editor: ⲡⲙⲁⲍ[ⲧⲟⲩ] introducing the fifth work — the summoning and scattering of the Five Sons of the First Man under the Zone.

3pl perfect verb governing 'the Zone'; the Five Sons grasp/bear the Zone as Omophoros bears the cosmos. Distinct from the immediately following ⲁⲩⲃⲓ ('they bore up under') which describes their second action with the burdens.
Completes line-break ⲡⲕⲟ-ⲥⲙⲟⲥ 'the cosmos' from preceding line ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲟ-. High certainty by orthography.

Distributive idiom 'some against X, others (ⲕⲉⲟⲩⲉ ⲁⲭⲙ̄) against Y'. Same construction recurs at line 25 with ⲁϩⲕⲁ ⲍⲛ̄ⲕⲉⲕⲁⲩⲉ. The three living words are deployed against deceit-places and molding-houses.
ⲡ[ⲙⲁ] ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲗⲟⲡⲉ — the place/region of deceit-stations; ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲗⲟⲡⲉ already means 'place of theft/deceit,' so the governing noun is a generic spatial term.

Definite article forming ⲡⲧⲱⲍⲙⲉ 'the summons/Call' as a heading: 'The Calling: that it should mingle with the five [worlds] of the [King of Darkness].' Aligns with the spiritual reading where the Five Sons' summoning purposes the constraining mingling of the dark Five.
Only the syllable ⲡⲗⲉ- survives at the start of an unidentified noun in a fragmentary line; could be ⲡⲗⲁⲛⲏ (Error), ⲡⲗⲏⲣⲱⲙⲁ, or another word; no formulaic anchor permits a confident fill.
Confirms editor: completes ⲁϩⲧⲱ[ⲛⲉ] 'he arose' — the Living Spirit rises after establishing the Zone to begin the sixth (governing) work.
Confirms editor: ⲁϩⲧ[ⲛ̄]-ⲛⲁⲩ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ across line break = ⲁϥⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲩ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'he sent forth' (powers and angels).
Confirms editor: ⲍⲛ̄[ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗ]ⲟⲥ 'angels' — Greek loanword in standard form, completing 'a multitude of powers and angels.'
Confirms editor: ⲛⲁ[ⲁ]ⲣⲭⲟⲩ 'they shall rule' (Greek loan ἄρχειν).
Confirms editor: ⲧⲍ[ⲱ]ⲛⲏ 'the Zone'.
Confirms editor: idiom ⲥⲁ ⲥⲁ ⲛⲓⲙ 'on every side' — the powers and angels rule the whole circuit of the Zone.
Confirms editor: ϣ[ⲁ]ⲛⲧⲉ 'until'.
Confirms editor: ⲉϩ[ⲥ]ⲙⲓⲛⲉ 'establishing,' the verb of the Living Spirit's structuring work.
Only the 2-character trace ⲁⲉ̣ survives at a sentence boundary with no syntactic anchor on either side; could open many particles or verbs.
Confirms editor: completes ⲛ̄[ⲛ̄ϩⲃⲏ]ⲟⲩⲉ 'of the works' (genitive after ⲁⲧⲍⲁⲏ 'at the end').
Confirms editor: ⲁϩϫ[ⲓ ϩ]ⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ 'he took some' — the providential dual disposition into storehouses and watch-stations.
Confirms editor: [ϩ]ⲓϫⲛ̄ 'upon' — placing others upon the watch-stations (ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲛⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲥ, the appointed sentinel-places).
Confirms editor: ⲧⲧ[ⲙⲁ]ϩⲥⲁϣϥ̄ 'the seventh,' introducing the consummating eschatological work.
Confirms editor: ϩ[ⲙ̄ ⲡ]ⲥⲏⲩ 'at the time' — temporal phrase governing the Ambassador's revealing.

Editor's restoration corrected to Lycopolitan: ⲡⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃ[ⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ ⲟⲩⲁⲛ]ϩ ⲁ[ⲃⲁⲗ] = 'the Ambassador manifested forth' (Lycop. ⲟⲩⲁⲛϩ for Sahidic ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ). Standard formula for the Third Ambassador's revealing of the glorious image — the awakening Call of Divine Truth at the consummation.
Confirms editor: completes ⲁ[ⲃⲁ]ⲗ 'forth' across line break, with ⲟⲩⲁⲛϩ from previous line.
Confirms editor: ⲍⲓⲕⲱ[ⲛ] 'image/icon' — the Ambassador's glorious icon, the revealed likeness that calls the captive light.
Confirms editor: ⲡⲓⲧⲛⲁ ⲉ[ⲧⲁⲛϩ ⲥⲙ̄ⲛ ϩⲛ̄] = 'the Living Projection was established in' — formulaic Manichaean phrasing for emanative establishment of a divine power.
Confirms editor: line-break completion [ⲛⲟ]ⲩⲧⲉ 'gods'.

Tentative continuation into next line where ⲁⲩⲉⲙⲁⲍⲧⲉ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁϩ appears: 'they (the gods and angels with the Projection) took hold of him' — i.e. of the whole built structure as one body. Reading explicitly: 'will take hold of the whole built structure.'
Confirms editor: ⲁ[ⲩⲉ]ⲙⲁⲍⲧⲉ 'they took hold' — 3pl perfect.
Reading: 'the whole construction stands as one against the King of Darkness.' Partial trace ⲧⲏⲣ[ϩ supports ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ '(the) whole'; predicate-of-unity ⲟⲩⲁ ⲡⲉ fits the ~8-character estimate.
1-2 character opener; 3pl perfect prefix introducing 'they (gods and angels) one against another, against the Light' — they array themselves as one host. Editor's ⲁ[.] is consistent.
Confirms editor: definite article [ⲡ]ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the Light' — the captive Light against which the cosmic struggle is waged.
Partial ⲉⲧⲁϩⲧⲁ- begins a relative perfect; reading: 'the Light captive in mingling.' Likely 'which has been [overcome / fallen] in the mingling.' ~8 characters fits ϩⲛ̄ ⲡⲙⲟⲩⲭⲧ̄.
Confirms editor: ⲕⲉⲛ[ⲁ]ϭ 'great' (qualitative adjective) — 'another great work, glorious.'
Confirms editor: [ⲉ]ϩⲁⲉⲓⲧϩ qualitative form 'lasting/extending'.
Confirms editor: ⲁⲧⲍ[ⲁⲏ ⲡⲁⲛⲁⲣⲓⲁⲥ] 'unto the end — the Last Andrias,' the consummating gathered statue of redeemed light at the cosmic finale.
Confirms editor: ⲁⲛⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲙ̄[ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ] 'unto the Aeons of the Light' — the homeward destination of all redeemed light, the standard formula closing the redemptive arc.

Only ⲛϩ_ⲃⲉ visible — verb stem cannot be confidently identified between candidates (ⲥⲱⲟⲩϩ family doesn't fit the ⲃⲉ ending; possible ⲱⲗⲃⲉ 'enclose' but no firm anchor). Reading suggests 'gather inward' but Coptic root resists.
Confirms editor: ⲛ[ϩⲉ]ⲙⲁⲍⲧⲉ 'and grasping' — circumstantial of ⲁⲙⲁⲍⲧⲉ 'seize'; the consummative seizure of the redeemed.
11-character lacuna with only marginal trace ⲛϩϩⲱⲕ; no formulaic anchor permits confident reconstruction of an object-phrase for 'seizing them [...]'.
Confirms editor: ⲛ[ϩ]ⲕⲱⲧ 'and building' — the constructive work of raising up the new Aeon.

12-character lacuna with only fragmentary traces ⲛϩⲧ . . . ⲛ̄ϩ . . . . . — likely two parallel objects of 'and building [X] [and Y] there' but without lexical anchor for the doubled noun-phrase, restoration would be invention.
Confirms editor: [ⲙ̄]ⲙⲁⲩ 'there' — locative adverb fixing the place of the new Aeonic building.
Section opens after a major break with no preserved trace; could be a connector (ⲡⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ 'this is') or a fresh subject — no formulaic anchor makes a fill defensible.
Confirms editor: relative-genitive construction [ⲧϩ ⲙ̄ⲡ]ⲉⲧⲥⲛⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ 'of the one who manifests them' — referring to the Ambassador whose revealing manifests the redeemed in the new Aeon.
Confirms editor: ⲥⲛ[ⲟⲩⲱⲛ]ϩ 'manifests them' — the verb of revealing characteristic of the Third Ambassador / Apostle.
Confirms editor (Lycop. variant): ϩ[ⲙ̄ ⲡⲁⲓ]ⲱⲛ ⲛ̄ⲃⲣ̄ⲣⲉ 'in this new Aeon' — the destination of the lifted structure, where the tree of glory and joy stands.
Confirms editor: ⲛϩ[ⲟⲩⲱϩ ϩⲙ̄ ⲡⲁⲓ] 'and they dwell in this [tree]' — the elect inhabit the Tree of Life of the new Aeon (continued in next section: 'tree which is there, of glory and joy').
